body:
## Summary

- refresh the Phase 0 stable-release aggregate source guard to current main after PR #653 (commit eb87c4965a8db6552af5a0901f72666129ab16e6)
- update open PR and merged PR snapshots so the audited merged range covers PR #568 through PR #653, with PR #568, #576, #627, and #646 excluded as closed-unmerged
- add the after-653 blocked evidence bundle with PR snapshots, CI run snapshots, gate summaries, command ledger, and SHA-256 checksums
- keep Phase 0 blocked: 13 required gates, 6 closed, 7 still blocking; PR #653 is Android no-Host UI/UX evidence only

## Verification

- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release tools.tests.test_phase0_module_ownership -v
- make evidence-tools-test
- make phase0-module-ownership-gate PHASE0_MODULE_OWNERSHIP_SUMMARY=docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-07-after-653-current-main-gate-blocked/phase0-module-ownership-summary.json
- make phase0-stable-release-gate PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT=eb87c4965a8db6552af5a0901f72666129ab16e6 PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_SUMMARY=docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-07-after-653-current-main-gate-blocked/phase0-stable-release-summary.json
- PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_REQUIRE_PASS=1 make phase0-stable-release-gate returns expected exit 2
- make phase0-stable-release-gate PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT=eb87c4965a8db6552af5a0901f72666129ab16e6 PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_REQUIRE_PASS=1 PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_SUMMARY=docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-07-after-653-current-main-gate-blocked/phase0-stable-release-summary.json returns expected exit 2
- shasum -a 256 -c docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-07-after-653-current-main-gate-blocked/SHA256SUMS
- git diff --check

## Still blocked

- macOS Host hardware compatibility matrix
- telemetry and external latency archive
- Host RSS two-hour no-growth
- native pointer HID mouse move/click acceptance
- controller runtime acceptance
- Android/macOS clipboard product E2E
- Android/macOS file-transfer product E2E
title: docs: refresh phase0 aggregate after PR 653
